acceptance_checks: scripts/test_shiki_governance_evidence.sh covers forged Guardian evidence, forged CCA evidence, forged ledger refs/integrity, stale mirror state, untrusted state-class mutation, missing evidence, exact Guardian evidence comments, and workflow static checks.

Guardian approval cannot be satisfied by label-only evidence, negative text, stale-head comments, unconfigured actors, CCA Review Bridge reviews, advisory Claude reviews, or close-but-not-exact approval phrases.
CCA completion cannot be satisfied by forged runtime verdict files or CCA evidence manifests with wrong repository, PR, head SHA, task/Goal, artifact, file entries, or digests.
Ledger evidence with malformed evidence_refs, mismatched ledger_integrity, wrong filename/id, unlisted ledger id, or wrong task/Goal scope is rejected.
Stale mirror state for expected PR, expected branch, expected head SHA, required check head SHA, or task status is blocked.
PR-authored workflow-runtime-evidence, cache, local-only, and unknown .shiki state paths are blocked by MergeGate state class policy.
Missing CCA, acceptance evidence, ledger evidence, required checks, required review, or Guardian live evidence remains blocking.
Workflow/static checks confirm Guardian evidence, CCA evidence manifest, CCA Review Bridge, MergeGate, and installer staging wiring stays present.
scripts/validate_shiki.py requires the governance evidence regression suite, docs markers, and template inclusion.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24 scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, targeted governance evidence test, git diff --check, and hidden/bidi check.
non_goals: Do not change Guardian policy semantics.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge semantics.
Do not change branch protection behavior.
Do not add a new state class model or change state class policies.
Do not redesign the CCA evidence manifest.
Do not add external signing, GitHub App, reviewer bot, KMS, GPG, or Sigstore support.
Do not broaden into P2 distribution, onboarding, packaging, or release work.
Do not add runtime adapter, provider, migration, or Node workflow compatibility work.
scope: Add adversarial forged, stale, and missing governance evidence regression coverage for Goal #30 P1.4.6 without changing Guardian, CCA Review Bridge, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, state class, CCA manifest, signing, runtime, provider, migration, Node, or P2 behavior.
